entities.name: Capitalism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: An economic system based on private ownership of the means of production, profit-driven enterprise, and market-based allocation of resources. Theorized by Adam Smith (1776), capitalism became the dominant global economic system, driving unprecedented wealth creation, industrialization, and globalization — alongside critiques regarding inequality and environmental degradation.
